Robotiq launches 2FC tactile gripper with Q1 2027 shipping planned

The 85 mm and 140 mm versions combine sensing, AI Hub compute and Contact Core for data capture and local grasp control.

RoboticsTomorrow ↗21 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

Preorders for a Physical AI gripper

Robotiq introduced 2FC on October 21 with 85 mm and 140 mm stroke versions available to preorder and shipping planned for Q1 2027. It builds on 2F with tactile sensors, wrist-mounted AI Hub compute and Contact Core software to use the same hardware for data collection and deployment.

Contact data and local responses

The gripper synchronizes pressure, vibration, proprioception, force, position and current at millisecond level. Robotiq describes onboard grasp-quality assessment, incipient-slip detection, object-pose estimation and centering, alongside planned ROS 2 and C++ development tools.

Upgrade options and specification limits

Existing 2F owners can add TSF sensors and AI Hub for Physical AI development without replacing the whole gripper. The stated two-million-cycle rating is not a guarantee of identical lifetime in every environment or perfect grasp success. Evaluation must account for actual objects and operating conditions.
